title.narrative: Support to Brazil's National Policy Dialogue IDF

description.narrative: "The purpose of the grant would be to support the new Brazilian Federal Government.s .Dialogue Towards a New Social Contract,. which aims to seek civil society input into, and to build consensus toward, the design of public expenditure prioritization and policy reforms that will drive achievement of Brazil.s recently-agreed fiscal targets . in turn critical to the government.s stated goal of sustainable growth with equity. The Program will be implemented through a recently-created Council of Economic and Social Development (CDES), chaired by Brazil.s President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The Council.s activities are being planned and conducted through a Special Secretariat for Economic and Social Development (SEDES). The Brazilian Presidency has sought World Bank support, through an IDF grant, to finance: 1. Establishment of a sustainable capacity in SEDES for consultation with civil society on public expenditure priorities and policy reform . including, inter alia, training and capacity building in consultative process, consensus building and action planning methodologies, design and analysis of public opinion research, communications and media relations skills and program impact and outcome evaluation; and 2. The first series of consultative seminars on strategic challenges (e.g., pension reform) and thematic .dialogues. on more local development issues (specific spending priorities for a state.s poorest region), where SEDES staff will have a chance to .learn by doing,. applying the consultative techniques they have learned through leading/facilitating these seminars. Once capacity has been established, it is expected that additional seminars would be financed by the Brazilian government. Support the ""National Dialogue"" to gather civil society inputs and build consensus towards the design of public expenditure prioritization and policy reforms."
